summary.text: James Taylor is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives from District 29 who took office on January 13, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Taylor and fellow incumbent Steve Montenegro advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary for the district's two House seats, with Ballotpedia listing 52.8 percent of the vote for Montenegro and 47.2 percent for Taylor.
In the general election he is on the ballot with Montenegro and Democrat Christine Scianna.
For 2025 and 2026 Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the House Education Committee and a member of the Public Safety and Law Enforcement Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
